name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A minimal show/hide disclosure with controlled and uncontrolled modes. Use it for a single expandable region where a full accordion is overkill.
docs: Named exports: Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsibleContent. Use `defaultOpen` for uncontrolled, or `open` with `onOpenChange` to drive it yourself. For several linked sections, use `accordion`.
